    <p>This is the exact prompt to build your own comment-to-DM bot with Claude. Copy it, paste it into Claude, and it walks you through every step.</p>
    <button type="button" onclick="navigator.clipboard.writeText(document.getElementById('prtxt').innerText);this.innerText='COPIED'">COPY THE PROMPT</button>
    <pre id="prtxt">I want to build my own comment-to-DM bot for Instagram, like ManyChat, without paying for a tool.

What it should do: when someone comments a keyword on one of my posts, they automatically get a DM from me with a button. When they tap the button, they get a second message with my link.

About me:
- I am not a developer. Explain every step like I&#x27;ve never done it before.
- My Instagram is a professional (Business or Creator) account.
- I want to use free tools wherever possible.

Please build this with me using:
- Instagram&#x27;s official API (the &quot;Instagram API with Instagram Login&quot;), so my account stays safe. No scraping, no unofficial apps.
- A Meta developer app connected to my Instagram account.
- A free host for the code (Cloudflare Pages with Functions, or another free option you think is simpler for me).
- A webhook that listens for new comments and new messages.

Rules for how you guide me:
1. Go one step at a time. Give me one step, wait for me to say &quot;done&quot; or send a screenshot, then give me the next one.
2. Tell me exactly where to click, using the names I&#x27;ll see on screen.
3. Never ask me to paste passwords, tokens or secret keys into this chat. Show me how to save them as secrets in the hosting tool instead.
4. Write all the code for me, and tell me exactly which file each piece goes in.
5. When something breaks, ask me for the exact error or a screenshot, then fix it.
6. When it works, help me test it end to end: I comment the keyword from a second account, the DM arrives, I tap the button, the link arrives.

Start by asking me:
- What keyword I want people to comment.
- What the first DM should say, and what the button should say.
- What link I want to send after they tap.

Then give me step 1.</pre>
